sections.text_helper: Section 6.10.2 "FLASH key register (FLASH_KEYR)" in chapter 6 (Embedded flash memory (FLASH)), RM0522 Rev 1, page 175.
sections.section_content:
Address offset: 0x004
Reset value: 0x0000 0000
This register can be protected against unprivileged access when PRIV = 1
inFLASH_PRIVCFGR. This register is write-only.
The following values must be programmed consecutively to unlock FLASH_CR and to allow
programming/erasing it. Awrong sequence locks FLASH_CR until next system reset.
1st key = 0x4567 0123
2nd key = 0xCDEF 89AB
Bits 31:0 KEY[31:0]: Nonvolatile memory configuration access unlock key

fields.name: KEY[31:0]
fields.description: Nonvolatile memory configuration access unlock key
